description: Revision log for benchmark/human_labels.json. Labels were first committed in 95ee5e0; six were revised in 0e9977a after a translation defect in the labeling tool was found. Every item affected by a translation defect is listed with its current status. Items flagged for re-review (#97, #115, #149) were re-reviewed by the author on 2026-10-08 and kept as 'residual'. Round 2 (human_labels_v2.json) is kept as exported by the labeling tool; its revisions are listed under round2_revisions and applied by analyze_human_labels.py.
